row: Equi-ed - Educator in Equine and Canine Therapy

We are Ireland's Leading Educator in Equine and Canine Specific Therapy and Welfare. Here at Equi-ed, we support our graduates with ongoing continuing professional development courses in associated complementary and alternative therapy modalities, providing a knowledge base unique in the equine training sphere.
